title: Dash speed
rootCause: The run vector retained fractional magnitude and was reused for dash/facing.
fix: Store a unit facing vector separately from analogue run magnitude; latch that unit direction for dash.

title: Residual velocity after dash
rootCause: Actual dash/pad displacement was fed back as controlled movement velocity.
fix: Keep controlled motionVelocity separate; snapshots still report total dash/pad/wind displacement. External launch vector survives air dash.

title: Terrain penetration
rootCause: Terrain query returned a higher floor when no support existed; ground snapping did not require a descending crossing from above.
fix: Return null without support; use previous foot height for descending crossings and bound grounded ramp following. Uphill ramp lip uses existing numerical contact tolerance at the straight-ramp/circular-tier seam. Canonical geometry and tuning unchanged.
test: QA-UNDERSIDE; actual-input browser trace; default fall/respawn, bridge, raised tiers, pads, old ramp-width and tower assertions

title: Drifter overlap
rootCause: The pulse chase-to-flee path produced a zero direction; dividing by fallback denominator1 still moved zero.
fix: Flee uses deterministic +X for zero direction, otherwise normalizes even very small nonzero vectors; consumes no RNG.
test: QA-DRIFTER-ZERO; exact/near-zero positions and deterministic actual CLI replay

title: Known event payload validation
rootCause: Output events were checked only for an object and type string.
fix: Validate the published v1.1 charm/theft/drop/night and fall-hit fields and numeric ranges with field-specific errors. Leave unknown v1.0 fields unconstrained.

title: Dash visual lifecycle
rootCause: Dash class was added once and never removed; forwards dash animation overrode later feedback.
fix: Derive dash class from active sim dash ticks; clear transient FX on screen transitions and prevent dash selector overriding warning/wind/pulse/hurt. Night3 identical shade body/eye meshes are instanced after correct visible FX exposed under-target software FPS; topology, transforms and materials are retained. Decorative HUD backdrop blur is removed and unchanged text writes skipped; text, layout and canonical colors remain identical.
test: Browser speed/expiry/pause/resume/retry/menu/terminal checks and visible real Night3 wind after dash

title: Partial lantern palette
rootCause: Partial-progress renderer branch used mote halo color for an unlit cage.
fix: Use canonical off cage color until lit=true; retain the existing scaled progress indicator and lit bulb state.
test: Actual-input partial3/10 material assertion #5B5F6E; screenshots; full-charge campaign
